name: Contrary Fusion
desc: Fusion Summon 1 Plant Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by sending 1 Plant monster from your Deck and 1 Plant monster from your hand or field to the GY, or by banishing 1 Plant monster from your GY as Fusion Material. The Fusion Summoned monster has its ATK and DEF swapped. Also take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
strings: Fusion Summon, swap ATK/DEF, and take control
